summary: Frontend-only regression testing completed for the MiniDev landing page. Build, official logos, both remote screenshots, captions, CTAs, FAQ, desktop navigation, and image loading passed; the mobile/main navbar is missing the required Screenshots anchor.

integration_issues.issue: The required Screenshots navigation link is absent from navItems, so users cannot reach #screenshots from the navbar/mobile menu. Footer Screenshots link is present and works.

action_items: Add a Screenshots entry/link to the primary navbar and mobile menu, targeting #screenshots.
critical_code_review_comments: App.js navItems omits screenshots while the requested screenshots anchor/navigation feature requires it; footer alone does not satisfy primary navigation.
seed_data_creation: None; static landing page, no APIs used.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Public preview tested at 1920px and began responsive checks at 768px/375px. Logos and both customer-hosted images loaded with nonzero natural dimensions; captions, Drive CTAs, FAQ, and no runtime error elements passed. Recheck navbar/mobile Screenshots link after fix, then complete remaining responsive widths.
rca of the issue: The screenshots section has id="screenshots" and a footer link, but the primary navItems array contains Overview, Features, Documentation, Requirements, and FAQ only. The mobile menu is generated from that same array, so neither primary nor mobile navigation exposes Screenshots.
